messages:
lina: Hi finance, booked a last-minute hotel for an onsite meeting. The hotel folio emailed back is just a single PDF showing total $289, no itemized room vs city tax vs resort fee. The corpcard charge is 'CITY HOTELS' for $289. Manager approved. How should I submit?
omar: @lina upload the folio to Expensify and add a short note stating manager approval + meeting name. If the hotel doesn't provide an itemized folio, we request a folio reissue from the hotel showing taxes and fees. If they can't, we can still process but need manager approval (you said ok) and a short explanation.
lina: Uploaded as `lina_289_hotel.pdf` and noted "Manager: Maggie; offsite sync 3/18". I replied to the hotel asking for an itemized folio but haven't heard back.
finance-bot: Policy: For lodging, an itemized folio is preferred. If not available, submit the folio + manager approval and finance will attempt to split taxes/fees at reconciliation. Transactions >$250 may require AP manual review.
maggie: Approved. @omar please route this to AP for manual coding. If hotel replies with itemized folio later, we can update and reclassify taxes.
omar: Got it. I'll assign GL 7001 for lodging and 2209 for taxes placeholder; AP will adjust if itemized folio comes in. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
